verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships AI features (Semgrep Assistant, AI-Powered Detection), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has no statement or control about excluding customer data from model training. Local-by-default scanning and the --dry-run no-upload flag are adjacent data-locality controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
